response: Folks in southern Alberta are out gathering signatures for that Water Not Coal petition Corb Lund launched last month. The thing demands the Government of Alberta prohibit through legislation all coal exploration. This gets dressed up as some ordinary citizens taking on big business, but anyone paying attention can see it's really progressive forces trying to handcuff Alberta's traditional industries. Those industries have delivered steady work and upheld family values across generations through hard work and responsible resource use. We ought to reject letting these petitions run the show and instead back the authority of the provincial government to deliver balanced development that strengthens our nation while putting the well-being of regular citizens ahead of radical environmental demands.
